# Home Assistant integration for UniFi Drive / UNAS v0.7.0 - Stability and test hardening

Maintenance release preparing the next distribution point after `v0.6.2`.

## Highlights

- Fixes snapshot target recovery so restored targets no longer keep stale
  missing-state counters.
- Avoids over-aggressive local `homeassistant` stub cleanup when the HA test
  helper package is missing, improving collection stability in some CI/test
  environments.
- Makes wake-on-LAN helper tests resilient to async plugin variation by running
  async checks via an explicit local event loop.
- Keeps integration architecture and feature surface unchanged; this release is
  focused on reliability and maintainability.

## Validation

- `python scripts/check_repo.py`
- `python -m ruff check custom_components tests scripts`
- `python -m pytest -q`
- `python -m compileall -q custom_components/unifi_unas tests`
- `git diff --check`
